name: Logoff Spot
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: TreeOfSelf
description: A simple and configurable drop-in mod to create a virtual text entity where a player logs off. Makes combat logging less effective and people with hacked clients less cool.
needs: Mixin: 11 points inside the game's methods
evidence: Server-side mod: Kiln runs mods' code on Horizon's single-player server, not on dedicated servers.
